comparison.binary_provenance: Frozen binaries were built from baseline 41fba70264 and the candidate working tree before committing. Production function and fixture hashes identify the measured code; subsequent changes only corrected filtered-out test fixtures and recorded results.

method.statistic: median of paired elapsed percentage changes
method.verification: Exact output strings and numeric arrays, matching checksums, and zero live counted bytes after each measured loop

scope.sparse_large: Sparse vector is first in the JSON object; trailing padding is 4096 or 65536 bytes. The raw extractor returns before scanning padding. These are copy-dominated fixtures, not a guarantee for arbitrary field positions or JSON shapes.
scope.text_large: Ordinary JSON title contains 4096 or 65536 bytes; compares latest fixes against previous PR head, where the ordinary slab already exists. This validates large payload behavior, not the original slab benefit versus main.
scope.embedding_identity_chunk: Derived unit-chunk identity with escaped document ID, including parent key ownership
scope.batch: Identity benchmark performs independent decodes; batch parameter is a reporting label and does not group allocations.

followup_controls.reason: Initial unchanged 64 KiB text path showed approximately +1% timing shifts; repeat both text batches and the neutral small sparse batch without selecting or discarding earlier samples.

counter_semantics.allocations: successful raw alloc calls; excludes resize/remap attempts
counter_semantics.moved_bytes: requested new sizes for successful moving remaps
counter_semantics.peak_live_bytes: logical requested storage; excludes allocator overhead, transient realloc overlap and RSS

limitations: Neutral confidence intervals do not prove zero CPU cost or statistical equivalence.
Host was not CPU-pinned; untouched text paths shifted around one percent in the first run, with follow-up intervals spanning zero.
Measured against the previous PR head, not main.
Broad integration suite not rerun; previous full-text repair failure remains unvalidated after main merge.

baseline_regression.result: Original decoder segfaulted in identity.deinit during injected allocation failure for a document embedding. Regression harness added only after freezing the baseline benchmark binary.
